name: Gale Blast
body:
School evocation [air]; Level druid/shaman 0, magus 0, sorcerer/wizard 0, witch 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range self
Area 5-foot burst centered on you
Duration Instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude partial; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You focus and release a burst of air, shunting your enemies away from you. Each creature within 5 feet of you takes 1d3 non-magical bludgeoning damage and is pushed directly away from you 5 feet. Any creature that is a size category larger than you is unaffected. A successful Fortitude save reduces the bludgeoning damage to 1 and the creature is not pushed back. If the pushing back would put the creature in immense danger, like shunting them off a cliff, they gain a + 5 bonus on the save.
